channel.title: Ubuntu candidate security fixes (prototype)
channel.description: Design prototype, not live security data. Security fixes that are testing in -proposed or the Ubuntu Pro Edge archive, before a security notice is issued.

item.title: CVE-2026-98432: Linux kernel candidate fixes
item.description: Fixes for a critical use-after-free in IPv4 TCP connection handling are testing for 27 kernel packages (41 candidate fixes) on Ubuntu 24.04, 22.04, 20.04, 18.04, 16.04 and 14.04 LTS. Released kernels are still vulnerable until a notice is issued.
